subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox own this specialized SSM-only AWS workspace service and its dedicated-account IAM and networking contract as a core deployment mode?
rationale: The PR adds a new core feature and operational security boundary; tests cannot establish target-account behavior or substitute for maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Approve the core direction once the documented redacted exact-head lifecycle and posture canary passes in the intended AWS account.

options.title: Narrow the patch
options.body: Retain reusable provider and default-credential improvements while deferring the dedicated service and CloudFormation stack.

options.title: Decline the mode
options.body: Close the PR if Crabbox should not own a specialized dedicated-account workspace service.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Approve the core direction once the documented redacted exact-head lifecycle and posture canary passes in the intended AWS account.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows the strongest ownership of AWS provisioning, coordinator lifecycle, and the recent capability surface extended here.
